note: One marker row as OZ_PdaPageMap's RebuildRows fills it. Line 1: a name at the server's cap (32 bytes = 16 Ukrainian letters) and, right-aligned, the coordinates with the distance -- the '>>' prefix marks the tracked marker. Line 2: the description as the script clips it, OZ_Text.Clip(desc, 64), which is the widest line the row can draw; the server allows 160 bytes and the panel's editor shows the whole of it.
